content.text: {"window_id":"w0011","observed_failures":[{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","description":"Predicted 2018-08-09 but marked incorrect; actual receipt date is 09/03/2018 (visible as 'Date: 09/03/2018'), so correct ISO is 2018-03-09. Agent interpreted DD/MM/YYYY wrong or confused with another date on receipt."},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","description":"Predicted 702.00 but incorrect; expected 102.00. OCR of 'Total incl. of GST 102.00' misread leading '1' as '7'. Also 'Total Amt Rounded 102.00' line exists but 'Toial' misspelling blocked keyword match."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","description":"Predicted 23.26 but marked incorrect; receipt shows final 'TOTAL: 23.25' after rounding adjustment of -0.01. Agent picked 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of the rounded TOTAL line that is the authoritative final amount."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","description":"Predicted null (empty); receipt clearly shows 'Grand Total : 92.80'. OCR likely produced 'GrandTotal' (no space) so '\\bGRAND\\s+TOTAL\\b' regex failed to match."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc1","summary":"GRAND TOTAL keyword regex requires whitespace between GRAND and TOTAL and misses OCR-concatenated 'GrandTotal' or variants with punctuation.","evidence":"078.jpg returned null despite 'Grand Total : 92.80' being clearly present; agent used pattern '\\\\bGRAND\\\\s+TOTAL\\\\b' which does not match 'GrandTotal'."},{"id":"rc2","summary":"Priority-tier selection does not prefer a post-rounding/final TOTAL line over an immediately preceding tax-inclusive total when both match the same tier.","evidence":"077.jpg: both 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' and final 'TOTAL: 23.25' match TOTAL tier; agent returned 23.26 instead of the final rounded 23.25. The current rule 'take last candidate' is correct in principle but the agent's implementation chose an earlier one or the trailing 'TOTAL: 23.25' line was dropped because it had no exclusion-safe context."},{"id":"rc3","summary":"Ambiguous DD/MM vs MM/DD disambiguation for dates with both components ≤12 is handled only by assuming DD/MM, with no secondary validation when earlier/later dates on the same receipt disagree.","evidence":"034.jpg: predicted 2018-08-09 means the agent parsed '09/08/2018' as DD/MM/YYYY, but the receipt's authoritative 'Date:' field is '09/03/2018' → 2018-03-09. The agent likely matched a different date string (e.g. a GST summary or barcode token) instead of the labeled 'Date:' line."},{"id":"rc4","summary":"Numeric OCR errors inside the keyword line are not corrected or sanity-checked, and no cross-check against subtotal/payment lines is performed.","evidence":"074.jpg: '702.00' was accepted as total even though 'Subtotal: 102.00', 'Payment: 102.00', and 'Total Amt Rounded 102.00' all indicate 102.00. The agent has no reconciliation step to detect that the chosen total is inconsistent with payment/subtotal."},{"id":"rc5","summary":"The image-ocr skill lacks guidance on preferring labeled 'Date:' fields over any date-like substring found elsewhere on the receipt.","evidence":"034.jpg date error. Skill DATE_PATTERNS scans every line in order and returns first match, with no priority for a line containing the literal label 'Date' / 'Dated' / 'Invoice Date'."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"GRAND TOTAL regex is too strict: '\\bGRAND\\s+TOTAL\\b' misses 'GrandTotal' (no space) and 'GRAND-TOTAL'. Should allow optional whitespace/punctuation between the two words."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Within a single priority tier, there is no sub-rule to prefer a line whose keyword is immediately followed by a value (e.g. 'TOTAL: 23.25' as the trailing standalone TOTAL) over a 'Total (Inclusive of GST): ...' line that appears earlier. The 'take last matching line' heuristic is stated but was not reliably implemented, and no tie-breaker favors shorter/standalone TOTAL labels at the receipt's bottom."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No reconciliation / sanity check: when the extracted total disagrees drastically with Subtotal, Payment, Cash, or Total Rounded values present elsewhere, the skill should prefer the value that is corroborated by at least one other labeled line."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction has no notion of label priority. Should first search lines containing 'Date', 'Dated', 'Invoice Date', 'Order Date', 'Tax Invoice Date', 'Receipt Date' (case-insensitive) and only fall back to unlabeled matches if none found. Also should optionally reject dates appearing inside long digit runs (barcodes, invoice numbers)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Common OCR digit confusions (7↔1, 0↔O/Q/D, 1↔l/I, 5↔S, 8↔B) are not optionally repaired when the resulting number would reconcile with another labeled amount on the receipt."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Documentation does not instruct the agent to prefer post-rounding totals: when both 'Total ... Incl GST' and a later 'Total Rounded' / 'TOTAL:' / 'Rounded Total' / 'Total After Rounding' exist, the rounded/final line should win regardless of exact keyword tier because it is the authoritative payable amount."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Loosen GRAND TOTAL (and similar multi-word keyword) patterns to tolerate missing/alternative separators: use '\\bGRAND[\\s\\-_:]*TOTAL\\b' and similarly for 'NET TOTAL', 'NETT TOTAL', 'TOTAL AMOUNT', 'TOTAL DUE', 'AMOUNT DUE', 'BALANCE DUE', 'CASH TENDERED', 'SUB TOTAL'."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an explicit 'final/rounded total' override tier that is checked BEFORE the standard priority tiers: keywords 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'ROUNDED TOTAL', 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', 'TOTAL AMT ROUNDED', 'NETT? TOTAL', and a standalone trailing 'TOTAL:' line that is the last TOTAL line on the receipt. If matched and a numeric value is extractable, use it."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Within a tier, when multiple candidate lines match, prefer in this order: (a) line that is the LAST occurrence AND whose extracted number is reconciled with Subtotal/Payment/Cash values on other lines (±0.05 tolerance); (b) line with the shortest/standalone keyword form (e.g. bare 'TOTAL:' over 'Total (Inclusive of GST):'); (c) last matching line as current fallback."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a reconciliation post-check: collect all numeric values from lines labeled Subtotal, Payment, Cash, Total Rounded, Grand Total, Change. If the chosen total disagrees with ALL of them by more than 0.05 but one of the OTHER candidate matches agrees, swap to the agreeing candidate."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite extract_date to use a two-pass strategy: Pass 1 search only lines containing a date label token (regex: '(?i)\\b(date|dated|invoice\\s*date|order\\s*date|tax\\s*invoice\\s*date|receipt\\s*date|trans(action)?\\s*date|bill\\s*date|print\\s*date)\\b'); if found, extract date from that line only. Pass 2 fall back to any line, but exclude dates embedded in runs of 10+ digits (invoice/slip numbers)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Document ambiguous date handling: default to DD/MM/YYYY (Malaysian/UK convention common in receipts) only when day ≤12 and month ≤12 cannot be disambiguated; otherwise use the unambiguous component to determine order. Add explicit examples in the skill."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add optional digit-correction pass for numeric tokens inside keyword lines: if the primary extracted number fails reconciliation but substituting one of {O→0, l→1, I→1, S→5, B→8, Z→2, g→9} yields a number that matches Subtotal/Payment/Cash, use the corrected value. Keep this as a last-resort step and log it."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSION_PATTERNS and document the semantic distinction: exclude a line only when the exclusion keyword is the LINE-INITIAL semantic label (e.g., 'Subtotal', 'GST payable', 'Tax Total'), not when it appears as a modifier phrase ('incl GST', 'inclusive of GST'). Provide the regexes and worked examples in the skill."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'GST/Tax Summary section' detector: once a line matching '(?i)\\b(GST|TAX|SST)\\s+SUMMARY\\b' is encountered, mark all subsequent lines as excluded from TOTAL candidate selection until a blank/separator line or end of text. Document this rule and example."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Update the batch pipeline documentation to require writing total_amount as a Python string formatted via f'{v:.2f}' and None on failure, and to use pandas object dtype so Excel receives a text cell, not a float. Reiterate that sorting is lexicographic by filename and that extension filtering is mandatory."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a Quality Self-Check item: 'For each receipt, verify the chosen total appears at least twice on the receipt (e.g. as both a TOTAL line and a CASH/Payment line) OR equals Subtotal + rounding; if neither holds, lower confidence and consider alternate candidates before accepting.'"}],"confidence":0.78}
